svg.title: Paired savings, and separate complete-suite observations
svg.desc: Controlled pairs come first. Matrix subset: baseline median 104.244 seconds, candidate median 50.687 seconds, median paired reduction 51.47 percent, about 2.06x faster, 3 pairs, 6 runs. Those bars use 4.2 pixels per second. CLI reads: median paired reduction 25.4 percent, 7 pairs, every pair improved. No absolute seconds are shown. That bar uses 4 pixels per percentage point on a 0 to 100 percent scale. Tooling stage: two separate single observations, not a paired measurement, Candidate A 486.782 seconds with 2 fragments and Candidate B 257.152 seconds with 4 fragments, at 1.4 pixels per second. Complete-suite points are separate observations with different content and configuration, not a controlled before/after. Bar length is minutes at 7.8 pixels per minute: 115.41 for the narrative-only validation, and stated seconds divided by 60 for the rest. 3,399.379 seconds is the narrative-only figure whose published rendering is 56.66 minutes. Candidate A is 2038.383 seconds, approximately 33m58s, and failed two source cases. Candidate B is 1817.171 seconds, 30m17.171s, passed, and is still above the 1800 second target. 1817.171 minus 1800 is 17.171 seconds.

g.text: Paired tests: how much time was saved
Same content, measured before and after.
3 pairs, 6 runs. Bar length is seconds.
baseline median against the candidate median
7 pairs. Every pair improved. Absolute seconds were not released.
Two separate single observations, not a paired measurement.
Different fragment counts: 2 and 4. One sample each. Bar length is seconds.
Separate observations with different content and configuration.
Bar length is minutes. Narrative-only figures have no structured field.
115.41 min. Narrative-only. Not the paired benchmark.
3,399.379 s (56.66 min). Narrative-only. No same-content control.
Candidate A. 2038.383 s, approximately 33m58s. Two source cases failed.
Candidate B. 1817.171 s (30m17.171s). Passed, still above the 30-minute target.
30-minute target. 1800 s. Candidate B is still above it.
1817.171 − 1800 = 17.171 seconds, so Candidate B is still above the target.
